{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of India|Cuisine of India]] | [[Cookbook:Pickle|Pickle]]

'''[[w:Chhundo|Chhundo]]''' is a sweet and spicy condiment or pickle eaten in the western state of India called [[w:Gujarat|Gujarat]] with [[w:roti|roti]] and [[w:Sabzi|Sabzi]].

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Kilogram|kg]] (2.25 [[Cookbook:Pound|lbs]]) [[Cookbook:Mango|mangoes]], deseeded
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] red [[Cookbook:Chile|chile]] powder
*2 tsp [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]] powder
*25 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (4 tsp) [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*2 tsp [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric]] powder
*600 g (1.25 [[Cookbook:Pound|lbs]]) [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]

==Procedure==
#Peel and finely [[Cookbook:Grating|grate]] the mangoes.
#Combine the grated mango evenly with the rest of the ingredients.
#Spread the mixture in a shallow, wide-mouthed jar and cover with a thin cloth.
#Keep the mixture in the sun for 5 days until the syrup attains a single [[Cookbook:Cooking Sugar#Thread Test|thread consistency]], stirring thrice daily.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*This is the basic recipe. To make a spicier variation, add red chili powder with the other ingredients while mixing.
*It can be preserved in glass bottles at room temperature.
